title: Diffusion contrast induced dynamics in a time-periodic competition-diffusion system with equal total resources
summary: This paper investigates a time-periodic, spatiotemporally heterogeneous competition-diffusion system, where two species have different intrinsic growth rates but equal total resources per period. Using asymptotic analysis and principal eigenvalue theory, we systematically examine its dynamics.
